structural_primary: Reciprocal-pair density: unordered distinct vertex pairs with at least one edge in each direction divided by choose(V,2); undefined for V<2
structural_null: Uniform permutation of edge target stubs conditional on exact source and target degree sequences; loops and multiedges allowed; exact enumeration only up to 8 edges in this version
null_degeneracy: constant score distribution is not informative; unsupported size or zero denominator is not testable
persistence: Untouched edge-occurrence survival is descriptive, compared to product(1-m/E_j); it is not repair, regeneration, replication, or a candidate promotion outcome
intervention_primary: Parent-level paired difference in changes of reciprocal-pair density: (target_h-target_0)-(sham_h-sham_0); horizon in successful events; undefined endpoints invalidate the pair
intervention_scope: Total effect under a fixed scheduler, including update-competition effects; does not identify local context-sensitive interaction
multiplicity: Holm adjustment separately over all prespecified structural tests and all prespecified intervention tests; include every attempted eligible test; no omission based on outcome
uncertainty: 95 percent percentile bootstrap over independent parent trajectories, 10000 resamples; resampling RNG and eligible family identifiers must be pinned in R03/R04 before execution; do not resample snapshots as independent
promotion: Both effect estimates >=0.05; both lower CI bounds >0; both Holm-adjusted p<=0.05; informative matched null; complete motif coverage; all frozen validation flags true; >=30 independent parents and >=2 schedulers; no scientific promotion before held-out intervention validation
split: SHA256 of UTF-8 parent key, first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 10: 0..3 discovery, 4..5 detector-development, 6..7 validation, 8..9 final-test; all branches/interventions inherit parent key
claim_limit: Passing numerical gates is operational prioritization, not evidence of life or context-sensitive causal emergence. R00 restrictions still apply.
missing_statistics: Gate consumes explicitly supplied frozen-validation statistics; R02 does not implement bootstrap estimators or claim power at n=30. R03/R04 must register design/power and tests before scientific use.
status: frozen_for_calibration; production eligibility requires later registered design
